metadata.title: Dynamic Ensemble Collage with Large Numeral Mask

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy ensemble composition featuring a large, white-outlined numeral '4' acting as a window for a cast of characters. The characters are captured in mid-action, throwing colorful liquid splashes (blue and orange) that break the frame of the numeral, creating a sense of depth and motion against a solid cyan-blue background.
coreVisualRelationships: Large numeral acts as a containment vessel for the character portraits.
Liquid splashes bridge the gap between the interior of the numeral and the exterior background.
High-contrast white outlines separate the primary graphic elements from the blue field.
Dynamic character poses directed toward the viewer create engagement.
coreInvariants: Thick white border around the central numeral.
Liquid splashes in contrasting blue and orange hues.
Portraits featuring expressive, high-energy facial expressions.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A massive numeral '4' dominates the center and right side of the frame, containing the majority of the cast.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized logo-like text in the upper left corner, balanced by the heavy vertical bar of the numeral.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, follow the diagonal of the numeral downward, and are led back up by the upward-splashing liquid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cyan-blue space surrounding the central graphic to allow the splashes to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue background providing a cool, vibrant base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White used for outlines and primary typography for maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Orange liquid splashes and red character clothing providing warm-toned energy.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all colors creates a youthful, commercial pop aesthetic.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters.
Lowercase styling for the primary display word.
Hard drop shadows to create separation from the background.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' and 'l' are merged or tightly overlapped.
The 'ee' characters are perfectly circular in their outer curves.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the background but behind the liquid splashes

composition.position: below display text and bottom center

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, stylized geometric display font paired with a clean, legible secondary sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Thick white keyline around the numeral
Red keyline around the main logo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight kerning potential.
Provides the necessary weight and modern commercial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid cyan-blue background. In the center-right, place a large, thick-outlined white numeral '4'. Inside the numeral, composite a collage of diverse, smiling people in energetic poses. Add digital liquid splashes in bright orange and translucent blue that appear to be thrown from the characters' hands, breaking out of the numeral's borders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold, lowercase geometric sans-serif title in the top left with a white fill and red outline. Add secondary metadata text in a clean white sans-serif at the bottom center and below the main title, ensuring all text has a subtle drop shadow for depth.

verificationChecks: Is the numeral '4' the primary framing device?
Do the liquid splashes overlap the borders of the numeral?
Is the background a consistent cyan-blue?
Is the main title text lowercase and outlined in red?

adjustableVariables: Numeral character used for the mask
Number of characters in the collage

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp masking of the numeral
Consistent studio lighting on all characters

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white outline of the numeral is crisp and uniform.
Check that the liquid splashes have realistic transparency and highlights.
Verify that the text kerning is tight but legible.
Confirm the color balance between the cool background and warm accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large geometric numeral mask with an ensemble cast collage, using vibrant liquid splashes to break the frame and bold, outlined lowercase typography for a high-energy commercial look.
